entries.text:
SEC. 6015. APPROPRIATE TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER FOR RURAL AREAS 
                          PROGRAM.

    Section 310B(i)(4) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development 
Act (7 U.S.C. 1932(i)(4)) is amended by striking ``2012'' and inserting 
``2018''.
